run_compute_upperbound_cli: run the compute upperbound script with --data-dir, --orientation-aware, --max-T, and --condition-on-action flags
run_prediction_upperbound: run prediction_upperbound to compute accuracy upperbound for a sequence of landmarks given neighborhood and boundaries
run_process_upperbound: run process to calculate upperbound accuracy across all configs for a given number of steps and action space
init_paths_agnostic: init paths agnostic to create 4x4 grid paths with location and landmark sequences for step-agnostic navigation
init_paths_aware: init paths aware to create 4x4x4 grid paths with orientation for step-aware navigation with turn actions
